reading_en:
[01 0C]In the early 1900s, a dark shadow
[01 0C]covered a small country town in
[01 0C]rural America.

[01 0C]At that time, a young married
[01 0C]couple vanished mysteriously
[01 0C]from their home.

[01 0C]The man's name was George,
[01 0C]and the woman's name was Maria.

[01 0C]Two years later, as suddenly as
[01 0C]he left, George returned.

[01 0C]He never told anyone where he
[01 0C]had been or what he had done.
[01 0C]But, he began an odd study,
[01 0C]all by himself.

[01 0C]As for Maria, his wife...

[01 0C]She never returned...







[00]
french_lines: Au début du XXe siècle, une ombre
Il ne dit jamais à personne
où il était, ni ce qu'il fit.
